name: input-event-listener
reason: Intentional difference (SPEC events): Anima listener responses occur on the next step to prevent step re-entry and recursive cascades. Sources: frames 13/28 in both; responses: Anima 14/29, Rive 13/28. This exact disagreement is retained, never a pass.

name: input-data-listener/internal-trigger-difference
reason: A native state-action trigger sets the trigger changed flag but does not run the view-model change listener (n stays 0); Anima delivers on change:$pulse after its step boundary (n becomes 9). Host data pulse=1 does invoke the native listener. This variant needs an owner design decision and is not verified parity.

name: input-align-preserve
reason: Intentional difference: Anima follows the pointer with the grab offset measured at pointer-down (x=88 on origin x=80; move to x=104 yields x=96). Native preserve-offset remains x=80 at the first move and after release; absolute delta 16. Neither result nor tolerance is normalized.

Independently specified Anima trace [0, 0, 5, 5, 12.5, 20]. Parent decision remains open; numeric/channel differences are retained.
